entities.name: Romanticism
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A cultural and intellectual movement (c. 1790-1850) emphasizing emotion, imagination, nature, and individual experience over Enlightenment rationalism. Romanticism transformed literature (Wordsworth, Goethe, Hugo), music (Beethoven, Chopin), painting (Delacroix, Turner), and philosophy (Schelling, Hegel), while inspiring nationalist movements and environmental consciousness.
